title: Nvidia hotfix 621.35 stops 30GB/hour SSD writes 💾
subject: nvidia
description:
Did you check your SSD writes? 👇

Nvidia released GeForce Hotfix Display Driver 621.35 on November 20 to fix excessive background writes to the nvlog.nvlgstg file, a bug users linked to drivers 621.14 and 621.24. The hotfix is a beta driver, and Nvidia says the safest option is to wait for the next certified release.

Sources: Nvidia support article 5940 (GeForce Hotfix 621.35), Notebookcheck (Nov 21, 2026), TweakTown (Nov 21, 2026), Windows Latest (Nov 20, 2026)

scenes.text: Nvidia just patched a driver that hammered SSDs.
Users traced the bug to GeForce drivers 621.14 and 621.24, released November 4 and 12.
A background service, NVDisplay.Container, kept rewriting one log file, even while the PC sat idle.
One user measured 515 megabytes in five minutes. Others estimated up to 30 gigabytes an hour.
On November 20, Nvidia put out hotfix 621.35 with a single fix for those writes. It's a beta, and Nvidia calls waiting for the next certified driver the safest option.
